name: @synapsegrid-labs/braincore
description: Evidence-native, self-hosted memory for agents and applications

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:ts && bun run build:dashboard
scripts.generate:openapi: uv run python scripts/export-openapi.py && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o packages/typescript/src/schema.ts
scripts.build:ts: bun build packages/typescript/src/index.ts packages/typescript/src/cli.ts --outdir dist --target node --packages external && bun build integrations/mcp.ts --outfile dist/mcp.js --target node --packages external && node scripts/typescript-native.mjs -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepack: bun run generate:openapi && bun run clean:dist && bun run build:ts
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/typescript-native.mjs -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --cwd dashboard typecheck
